paragraphs: Perida. R' Yose ben Perida, a Tanna; [Eruvin 11b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.11b.28).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rabbi Eliezer goes to Rabbi Yose ben Perida, whom the passage explicitly calls his disciple.
The account continues at [Eruvin 12a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.12a.1), with a discussion about adding a second side post to an alleyway in Ovelin.
